audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart read 'Skill' on all seven rows; content and packet read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Hwei/Hwei.
audit.why: Death's Hand reaches 750 and Nevermove 850, both shorter than Hwei's paint range, so 1-5 belong to Hwei. Level 6 is the one contested row because Demonic Ascension's 650 drain runs indefinitely while it feeds.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to match the packet and content chart; level 6 stays Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Swain cooldown appeared anywhere, and Demonic Ascension was described as a fixed-duration burst window.
audit.why: Riot's R text: the form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions. That changes the advice from 'wait it out' to 'leave the 650 circle so it stops feeding'. Death's Hand also falls from 7s to 3s across ranks — that is his real lane spike.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, spikes[1].text and report[5].t rewritten with 120s, 650, and the feeding condition.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors on the same ability: Swain's E is called 'Torment' (its name is Nevermove), and the PULL is credited to his ultimate ('Demonic Ascension pulls in a wide radius', 'the pull radius').
audit.why: Riot's E text: he launches a wave forward, it returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits, and he can then pull all rooted champions closer. The root lands on the RETURN pass, and the pull is E's recast — the ultimate only drains and slows. For an immobile champion that distinction is the entire dodge: you are safe walking through the outbound wave and get rooted by the one coming back.
audit.corrected: Name fixed everywhere in scope; the return-pass root and the E recast pull are now stated in winCon, tradeBad, cooldowns and spikes[0].

audit.why: Ravenous Flock heals him off collected Soul Fragments and permanently raises his max health, so report[8]'s existing early anti-heal line is right for this matchup. I left it alone and grounded the reason in dosFull[1].d instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets and breakdown.cooldowns with no digit.
audit.why: Both bled bullets restate tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to match their titles; real cooldowns written in.

edits.before: Swain's kit is slow and telegraphed — Death's Hand travels in a line and Torment has short root range, both of which your longer Q/E poke punishes cleanly. He can't out-trade you level 1-2 without landing that root first, and even then your damage output is higher per rotation. Keep your distance, poke every time his root is down, and you win nearly every extended trade through level 5.

edits.before: You continue winning trades level 3-5 with the same range advantage, but respect his level 6 Demonic Ascension — it's a big AoE drain-heal zone that can turn a losing fight around if he catches you or your teammates inside it. As long as you play the edges of engagements and don't stand in the pull radius, his ultimate does little more than heal him back to full without netting a kill. Keep poking outside the zone and disengage if he commits the ult early.
edits.after: You continue winning trades level 3-5 with the same range advantage, but respect his level 6 Demonic Ascension — a 650-radius drain that runs indefinitely while it feeds and turns a losing fight around if it catches you. notes:
Chart: full layer read "Skill" on all seven rows; content win[N] and packet.levelChart both read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Hwei/Hwei. Six full-layer sides moved to Hwei (level 6 already Skill). No paired win[N] edits are included because win[N] is already correct on disk.

Fabricated ability name killed: Swain's E was called "Torment" twice. It is Nevermove.

The pull was credited to Demonic Ascension in two places. The pull is Nevermove's recast on rooted champions; the ultimate only drains and slows. The root also lands on the RETURN pass, which is the actual dodge and was never stated anywhere on the page.

Demonic Ascension has no fixed duration — Riot's text says the form is indefinite as long as Swain drains champions. The advice changed from 'wait it out' to 'leave the 650 circle'.

Early anti-heal in report[8].t is correct here and I left it.
